temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan confirms he has been keeping something important from Christian: he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes him anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan admits he was hiding something, confirming Christian's suspicion and revealing that the hidden matter is trouble Jonathan is in.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan was hiding something important and is in trouble, but the exact nature of the trouble is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious before; worried and concerned after learning Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth about what Jonathan is hiding and learn more about Jonathan's trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan is reluctant to drag Christian into the situation but accepts Christian's offer of help and says he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan was hiding something important and is in trouble, though the nature of the trouble is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan accepts Christian's help, confirming that Jonathan needs support and resources and that Christian can assist him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in trouble and needs Christian's support; Christian believes they can face the situation together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support, and help Jonathan figure out a way out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure whether the trouble is illegal; he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but claims he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and needs Christian's support; Christian believes they can face it together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian now suspects Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or the wrong people, though Jonathan denies personal wrongdoing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble may be connected to criminal activity or dangerous people, but Jonathan may not have committed a crime himself.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly and find out more without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed and that someone is trying to set him up; Christian has some leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or the wrong people; Jonathan claims he did not do anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian shifts from suspecting possible criminal involvement to believing Jonathan is innocent and is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and the real culprit is still unknown, though Christian has leads to pursue.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name by gathering evidence that proves his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out that the real culprit is someone both he and Jonathan know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed; the real culprit is unknown, but Christian has leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian identifies the person behind the framing as someone close to both him and Jonathan rather than an unknown stranger.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is responsible for framing Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, while being careful because they are dangerous.
